description.zh: 覆盖分子与细胞生物学、遗传学、基因组学、生物信息学、实验设计和文献研判；强调证据分级、可复现分析、质量控制及遗传隐私。
description.en: Expert in molecular and cell biology, genetics, genomics, bioinformatics, experimental design, and literature appraisal, with rigorous evidence grading, reproducibility, quality control, and genetic privacy safeguards.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你的生物学问题、研究对象、数据类型和目标；我会先澄清证据与约束，再给出可验证的分析或实验方案
welcome_message.en: Share your biological question, study system, data type, and goal; I will clarify evidence and constraints before proposing a verifiable analysis or experimental plan

description.zh: 梳理功能、证据、机制与不确定性
description.en: Map function, evidence, mechanism, and uncertainty

prompt.zh: 请分析以下基因、位点或变异。先确认物种、参考基因组版本、转录本与命名，再区分已知事实、推断和未知项，梳理功能、通路、表型证据、群体频率、保守性及可能机制，并给出可验证的下一步。若涉及人类健康，请仅作科研与教育性解释：
prompt.en: Analyze the following gene, locus, or variant. First confirm species, reference assembly, transcript, and nomenclature; then separate established facts, inferences, and unknowns, covering function, pathways, phenotype evidence, population frequency, conservation, possible mechanisms, and verifiable next steps. If human health is involved, keep the interpretation research- and education-focused:

description.zh: 从假设、对照到统计和复现
description.en: From hypothesis and controls to statistics and replication

prompt.zh: 请为以下科学问题设计实验。明确可证伪假设、模型系统、自变量与因变量、阳性/阴性/载体/批次对照、生物学与技术重复、随机化与盲法、样本量依据、测量方法、统计计划、成功判据、常见失败模式及替代方案：
prompt.en: Design an experiment for the following scientific question. Specify a falsifiable hypothesis, model system, independent and dependent variables, positive/negative/vector/batch controls, biological and technical replicates, randomization and blinding, sample-size rationale, measurements, statistical plan, success criteria, common failure modes, and alternatives:

description.zh: 建立可复现的端到端分析流程

prompt.zh: 请为以下组学项目制定端到端分析方案。说明研究设计、元数据、原始数据质控、参考数据库与版本、预处理、批次效应、统计模型、多重检验、功能解释、敏感性分析、可视化、复现环境、结果验证和交付物：
prompt.en: Create an end-to-end analysis plan for this omics project. Cover study design, metadata, raw-data QC, reference databases and versions, preprocessing, batch effects, statistical models, multiple testing, functional interpretation, sensitivity analyses, visualization, reproducible environments, validation, and deliverables:

description.zh: 评价方法、因果性、偏倚与可重复性
description.en: Assess methods, causality, bias, and reproducibility

prompt.zh: 请批判性解读以下生物学论文、摘要或结论。区分作者观察与机制性主张，评价研究设计、统计功效、对照、混杂、效应量、多重检验、外推边界、数据与代码可得性、复现性，并提出最关键的验证实验：
prompt.en: Critically appraise the following biology paper, abstract, or claim. Separate observations from mechanistic claims; assess study design, power, controls, confounding, effect sizes, multiple testing, generalizability, data/code availability, and reproducibility; then propose the most decisive validation experiments:

description.zh: 按证据定位失败环节与根因
description.en: Localize failure points and root causes from evidence

prompt.zh: 请系统排查以下实验异常。先整理预期、实际结果、原始记录和最近变更，再按样本、试剂、仪器、操作、环境、分析与批次建立假设优先级；为每个假设给出最小判别实验、必要对照、停止条件和记录方式：
prompt.en: Troubleshoot the following experimental anomaly systematically. First organize expected versus observed results, raw records, and recent changes; then prioritize hypotheses across samples, reagents, instruments, handling, environment, analysis, and batches. For each hypothesis, give a minimal discriminating test, required controls, stop criteria, and documentation method:

description.zh: 按层次讲清机制、证据与例外
description.en: Explain mechanism, evidence, and exceptions by level

prompt.zh: 请讲解以下生物学或遗传学概念。先给出直观图景，再按分子、细胞、个体或群体层次解释机制，说明支持证据、典型例子、常见误区、重要例外和仍未解决的问题，并附术语表与进一步学习路线：
prompt.en: Explain the following biology or genetics concept. Start with an intuitive picture, then explain mechanisms across molecular, cellular, organismal, or population levels; include supporting evidence, canonical examples, common misconceptions, important exceptions, open questions, a glossary, and a learning path:

zh: 每周一「09:00」追踪我关注基因与通路的新论文，按证据强度汇总
每周三「10:00」检查组学项目的质控、批次效应和待验证结果
每周五「17:00」整理本周实验记录、异常、结论与下周验证计划
每月 1 日「09:30」复盘研究假设、关键证据缺口和项目优先级
每两周周二「14:00」更新指定基因集的功能注释与数据库版本变化
每天「18:00」汇总新录入样本的数据完整性、命名和元数据问题
en: Every Monday at 09:00, track new papers on my genes and pathways of interest and grade the evidence
Every Wednesday at 10:00, review omics-project QC, batch effects, and findings awaiting validation
Every Friday at 17:00, summarize experiments, anomalies, conclusions, and next week's validation plan
On the 1st of each month at 09:30, review research hypotheses, critical evidence gaps, and project priorities
Every other Tuesday at 14:00, update functional annotations and database-version changes for a specified gene set
Every day at 18:00, summarize data completeness, naming, and metadata issues in newly entered samples
